name: devin_glm_5_2_skill_e2e
description: Run all eight packaged tax workflows in isolated Devin CLI workspaces with the free glm-5-2 model, the matching local skill, real source documents, saved trajectories, and hidden graders.
given: Eight immutable task workspaces with source_docs and project-local skills, with hidden tests kept outside each agent workspace.
when: Each workflow is executed by a fresh Devin CLI session using glm-5-2 and all outputs and trajectories are independently inspected.
then: Every accepted trajectory reports GLM-5.2 High, no hidden test path is present, every required deliverable parses, and every hidden grader returns reward 1.0.
